correctness.rationale: At poles x=0,infinity, both break orders are 2, giving genus4 and 3-rank2. The geometric automorphism C3 is explicitly an imported primary lemma, not independently proven here; its trivial F3 Galois action yields exactly three twists via H^1(Frob,C3). Independently enumerated all affine F_(3^m) solutions (plus two rational pole points) for 1<=m<=4, obtaining tables [5,5,44,113], [2,8,44,44], [5,17,44,89]. Newton identities and genus-four functional equation give three claimed degree-eight Weil numerators. Independently factored mod2 as quartic+quartic and mod5 as quadratic+sextic with irreducible components: incompatible proper-degree choices show Q irreducibility and hence simplicity; distinct numerators give nonisogeny over F3. Slopes 0²,(1/2)^4,1².
